environment: LOCAL; real Edge + official OAuth MCP SDK; no external email

cases.name: Generated provision HTTP routes retain authentication, same-origin and Admin-only boundaries
Real Admin form reveals a new password once; user logs in immediately without a mandatory change
Closing the one-time display clears it; account lists and history contain no recoverable password
Official OAuth MCP SDK discovers the opt-in contract and receives the new generated password in its first creation response
MCP and native retries do not redisclose secrets; broad secret reads and supplied password inputs remain blocked
MCP-created customer can use their own portal immediately and may voluntarily change the password afterward
